nodes.name: DiffEngine
nodes.docstring:
Compute structural diffs between two version snapshots.

    Pure functions — no I/O, no side effects. All inputs are dicts/dataclasses.
    Supports both L1 (feature-level) and L1.5 (block-level) diffs.

nodes.name: compute_l1_diff
nodes.docstring:
Compute L1 feature-level diff.

        1. Match features by feature_id
        2. Classify each as added/removed/attribute_changed/unchanged
        3. Compare feature_relations (edges) for edge-level diffs
        4. Upgrade unchanged→dependency_changed when edges change
        5. Apply priority rules (added > removed > dep_changed > attr_changed)
        6. Compute summary counts

nodes.name: compute_l1_5_diff
nodes.docstring:
Compute L1.5 block-level diff. Same algorithm as L1 but on blocks.

        Uses block_id for matching, compares label and responsibility.

nodes.name: _upgrade_dependency_changed
nodes.docstring:
Upgrade unchanged/attribute_changed → dependency_changed for nodes with edge changes.

        Priority rules:
        - added/removed are terminal — never upgraded
        - dependency_changed > attribute_changed
        - If node was attribute_changed, move attribute details to secondary_changes

    以快照數量為單位，根據 max_snapshots 上限決定保留/清理。
    手動快照（trigger="manual"）和有 git_tags 的快照受保護。

nodes.name: compute_retention
nodes.docstring:

        Algorithm:
        1. If enabled=False → all in to_retain, to_remove empty
        2. Classify: protected (trigger=="manual" OR git_tags non-empty) vs unprotected
        3. Protected always in to_retain
        4. Unprotected sorted by timestamp descending (newest first)
        5. Keep first max_snapshots unprotected, rest in to_remove
        6. Return RetentionDecision(to_retain, to_remove)

        Edge cases:
        - max_snapshots <= 0 → all unprotected in to_remove
        - Empty list → empty RetentionDecision

        Guarantee: to_retain ∪ to_remove = all input, to_retain ∩ to_remove = ∅

    Diff_Graph_ViewModel (default sort order per Req 10 AC1).
    Frontend only needs to re-sort when user switches to semantic-diff-first.

    Edit distance uses difflib.SequenceMatcher ratio converted to character count.
    Nodes with higher magnitude rank first.

    Returns a new sorted list (does not mutate input).
